picks.name: Art in the Pearl
picks.description: Labor Day closes out with Portland's biggest art & craft fair spreading across the North Park Blocks — 100+ juried artists, live craft demos, music, and a hands-on area for kids. Free to wander all day.

picks.name: Mt Tabor Monday
picks.description: The Curbside Serenade series brings a free evening of live music up to Mt Tabor, featuring Nicolas James and Erina McLaren. Pack a blanket and a picnic and settle in on the hill.

picks.name: Pre-Inflation Tuesday
picks.description: Sugar Hill turns back the clock with throwback prices every Tuesday — a sweet, cheap excuse to stop in on SE Belmont. $3 burgers, fries, beers, and tequila. $1 oysters (get there early because they sell out).

picks.name: Buzz Words: A Tipsy Spelling Bee
picks.description: A boozy twist on the grade-school classic at The Social Spoon — sign up to compete or heckle from the crowd. Bring your worst spelling and your best liquid courage.

picks.name: Clay Commons Ceramic Market
picks.description: Downtown's Director Park fills with local ceramicists selling mugs, bowls, and one-of-a-kind pieces straight from the studio. A free, family-friendly afternoon of handmade clay.

picks.name: ScreamSocietyPDX
picks.description: Exactly what it sounds like: gather on the Eastbank Esplanade and let out a collective scream to shake off the week. Free, cathartic, and very Portland.

picks.name: Time-Based Art Festival
picks.description: PICA's Time-Based Art Festival is a two-week whirlwind of boundary-pushing performance, dance, and live music staged all over the city. Check the schedule and pick your adventure.

picks.name: Stranger Things, the Musical Parody
picks.description: Funhouse Lounge goes to Hawkins with a campy, song-filled parody of Stranger Things. Upside-down laughs, big '80s energy, the kind of thing the Funhouse does best.

picks.name: Ankeny Alley Street Fair + Portland Staycation Weekend
picks.description: Old Town's Ankeny Alley turns into a free street fair — vendors, performers, and art — as part of Portland Staycation weekend. Wander, snack, and soak up downtown. Find deals on hotels and treat yourself without traveling!

picks.name: AMP Music Festival
picks.description: AMP takes over the Star Theater with a stacked local lineup — Matt Cameron, Jenny Don't & The Spurs, Altar Girl, and more. One ticket, a full night of Portland rock.

picks.name: 6th Annual Tomato Fest
picks.description: The Culinary Breeding Network's beloved Tomato Fest returns to SE Division — taste dozens of tomato varieties straight from the region's growers. Free, delicious, and peak late-summer.

picks.name: Oktoberfest at the German Haus
picks.description: The German American Society throws open the Haus for beer, brats, and oompah music from noon till nine. Cheap entry, big steins, and proper Gemütlichkeit in NE Portland.

picks.name: Downtown Sunday Parkways
picks.description: The season's final Sunday Parkways closes downtown streets to cars for a 2+ mile loop of biking, walking, and rolling. Free, family-friendly, and the last one of the year.

picks.name: Drink & Draw
picks.description: Bring a sketchbook to Portland's beloved goth bar for a laid-back Drink & Draw — sip something dark and doodle among the cobwebs. All skill levels welcome; get the creative juices flowing.
